deep_dive.title: SPO: Discovering Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Operators via Stackelberg Program Optimization
deep_dive.abstract: Large neighborhood search (LNS) relies critically on destroy and repair operators, whose effectiveness depends on both adaptation to the evolving LNS state and interaction between the two roles. We introduce Stackelberg Program Optimization (SPO), an LLM-based framework for discovering adaptive executable destroy-repair programs. SPO conditions operator decisions on a compact LNS state, allowing state-dependent behavior to emerge through program discovery, and organizes destroy-repair discovery as a Stackelberg interaction over program space that reflects their asymmetric dependency. Role-specific credits evaluate destroy programs as leaders and repair programs as conditional follower responses, guiding a coupled optimization process that combines LLM generator learning with population-based evolutionary search over programs. Experiments on the traveling salesperson problem and capacitated vehicle routing problem show that SPO outperforms strong baselines across a broad range of settings and generalizes beyond the discovery scale to larger instances and benchmark sets. Behavioral analyses further demonstrate state-dependent operator behavior and coupled destroy-repair improvement during discovery.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Large neighborhood search depends on destroy-repair operators whose adaptivity and mutual interaction are hard to design. SPO uses an LLM to discover adaptive executable destroy-repair programs cast as a Stackelberg game over program space.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 大邻域搜索依赖破坏与修复算子，但算子的自适应性与两角色交互设计困难。本文提出Stackelberg程序优化框架SPO，利用大语言模型发现可执行的自适应破坏-修复程序，将两者建模为程序空间上的主从博弈并设计角色特定信用评估。实验表明该方法能自动发现状态相关的算子程序，为LLM驱动的组合优化算法自动发现提供了新范式。
